caption: The drawing features a quilt-like pattern on a beige or off-white background with a grid of diagonal lines forming diamond shapes across the entire space. There is a large stylized flower in the center composed of concentric petal-like shapes in shades of red, pink, and yellow, surrounded by green leaves, some with red tips. Four similar, but smaller, flowers are positioned near each corner, featuring red and pink concentric petal shapes with yellow centers. Along the bottom and left edges, there is an intricate border consisting of curved green, red, and yellow bands with stylized green leaf and red diamond elements extending inward. In the top right and top left corners, there are subtle, embossed-like designs of flower and leaf forms that are of similar color to the background, making them less prominent visually. The overall composition is symmetrical and orderly, focusing on the repetitive use of flower, leaf, and curved border motifs in specific color patterns.
title: Applique Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
